purpose: Measure whether Future Branch actually predicts useful next states and reduces user waiting instead of merely describing proactive behavior.

score_classes.exact: The actual next input/state was explicitly represented by a prior ranked branch family.
score_classes.partial: A neighboring broader family existed, but the important specific branch was not prepared explicitly.
score_classes.miss: No materially useful prior branch represented the actual next input/state.

events.reason: The prior field anticipated a correction that something should have been prepared, but did not explicitly anticipate the user checking whether the prediction check itself had been predicted.
events.correction: Promote self-audit/meta-verification to a first-class likely-input branch and measure future exact/partial/miss behavior.
